name: real-constraint-gate-exhaustion
description: Write tests for constraint-gate exhaustion state recording
system_prompt:
You are a coder agent implementing: Write tests for constraint-gate exhaustion state recording

## Task

Add tests to constraint_gate_wiring_test.go verifying that when evaluateConstraintGate fails a task (both max-retry exhaustion and early-termination paths), two new context keys are set:
- `constraint_gate_exhausted`: true
- `constraint_gate_failed_at_commit`: the HEAD SHA of the feature worktree at failure time

Test 1 (TestConstraintGateWiring_ExhaustionState_MaxRetries): Set up a parent at MaxConstraintGateRetries-1 retries with past next_check and a failing constraint worktree. Call evaluateConstraintGate. Assert task is FAILED, context has `constraint_gate_exhausted`=true and `constraint_gate_failed_at_commit` is a non-empty string matching the HEAD SHA of the feature worktree (use worktree.RunGit(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], featureDir) to get expected SHA).

Test 2 (TestConstraintGateWiring_ExhaustionState_EarlyTermination): Same as the existing early-termination test setup (master clean, feature violating, previous_failed=1). Call evaluateConstraintGate. Assert task is FAILED and both exhaustion context keys are set.

Test 3 (TestConstraintGateWiring_ExhaustionState_ClearedOnPass): Use constraintPassWorktree. Set constraint_gate_exhausted=true and constraint_gate_failed_at_commit="abc123" in context alongside other gate keys. Call evaluateConstraintGate. Assert both new keys are cleared (they should be in constraintGateContextKeys).

Existing helper functions to use: constraintFailWorktree, constraintPassWorktree, setupTestRepoWithMainBranch, testOrchestrator, runGitCmd, createFeatureWorktree. All defined in orchestrator_test.go and constraint_gate_wiring_test.go.

The tests will fail initially because evaluateConstraintGate doesn't yet set these keys and constraintGateContextKeys doesn't include them.

## Working Directory

.

## Verification

Write all code changes, then run `go vet ./... && go test ./...` in a SINGLE bash command.
If tests fail, read ALL errors, fix in one pass, re-run once more. Max 2 verification cycles.

## Test Infrastructure Rules

- DB init in tests: use `testutil.NewTestDB(t)`, never `gorm.Open` directly.
- Shared test helpers live in `internal/testutil/testutil.go`; do not define local `createTest*`, `setupBareRepo`, etc.
- Use `testutil.SetupBareRepo(t)`, `testutil.CommitFile(t, ...)` for git test helpers.

## Commit

When tests pass, `git add` new/modified files and `git commit` with a descriptive message.
Do NOT push to remote.
